scope: Seven family shape references and one unfinished-billet reference. Final H/I/W/Q24 sprites are independently authored at native pixel resolution using repository pixel tooling, not resampled tool rasters.

records.name: optic
records.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: original low-resolution side-view pixel-art component for an existing fictional inventory game.
Edit the attached component into a premium workshop-made variant: a reinforced compact holographic optic casing with a stepped protective roof, open viewing window, articulated base clamp and one tiny muted-brass rivet near the upper left of its casing.
Maintain the source side profile, footprint, horizontal east-facing orientation and mounting interface position. Introduce a visible structural redesign beyond a palette change. The brass rivet is a small craft detail, not a logo. Keep a restrained steel-gray palette, one-pixel dark ink outside contour, crisp integer-grid edges, upper-left light, genuine transparent background. No text, numbers, branding, watermark, scenery, hands, glow, shadows or antialiasing. Do not include a full weapon. Intended as shape reference for native tiny game sprites.

records.name: blank
records.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 24x24 pixel-art inventory material icon.
One unfinished precision-machining billet, a short rectangular stepped steel blank with a chamfered corner, a shallow unfinished recess and one small brass locating pin. It should clearly read as raw workshop material, not a finished accessory. Native crisp small pixel art, upper-left highlight, one pixel #122027 outside ink. Palette #122027 #24373d #425a60 #829c9d #bdcfca and #c09a55 only, maximum 8 opaque colors. Full billet centered within square with transparent margins. True transparent background. No writing, numbering, logo, watermark, hand, gun, scene, shadow, glow or antialiasing.
